reviews.x: I was trying to find Naked Bee's sandalwood scent (my favorite) but it doesn't seem to be available at this time. The Nag Champa blend is a good substitute in  terms of scent. Like all Naked Bee lotion products I've tried it is great at keeping the skin soft and smooth.

I am really impressed with these two hand creams. I bought them based on reviews and am not disappointed. I was so tired of using hand creams full of chemicals and or that smelled like your grandmother's bathroom (think talcom powder and roses). This scent is a bit musky and yes, definitely sandlewood but it also has lavendar, calendula, witchazel and so many other natural emollients. It is so unique in the smell that I cannot quite describe it but it's musky and lovely.  I wore it today and kep

reviews.t: Smells divine - not like fruit or food!
reviews.x: Totally love the smell and feel of this product. I don't need to wear perfume if I just put this on my hands once in awhile (perfume is too strong anyway). I do miss the Sandalwood, though, which was replaced by this fragrance. I so appreciate fragrance that are not fruit or food smell based, which I think are gross.

The Naked Bee is a light yet wonderfully moisturizing lotion that feels and smells great. It was a nice surprise to see it in Nag Champa scent - spicy, earthy, slightly sweet but not overpowering. It's a scent off the beaten path for a lotion. Will definitely order again.
I got hooked on their sandalwood lotion right before it was discontinued but this is just as good, if not better. Love it!

reviews.t: Love Naked Bee's the sandalwood aroma
reviews.x: Great product.  Smells good, it's not greasy and the aroma lingers on the skin a good part of the day.

The scent is strong and yet very nice. The ingredients are great and I did not have any reactions (I have sensitive skin). Definitely a brand and scent I would buy again. As a side note, I also purchased the "hippy peace" lotion by another company that claimed to have nag champa scent, that one did NOT have good ingredients and the scent was not as accurate as this one. I'd recommend The Naked Bee products.

The scent of this lotion is the best aromatherapy for stress I've ever found. I can feel my blood pressure drop every time I use it. The lotion itself is really nice, too: it feels like it's too light to be effective, but I live in the desert and it's perfect to use on my hands throughout the day.

This lotion is one of the best lotions I've ever used.  It softens your skin so much and you don't have to keep putting more on during the day as you do with other lotions.  I totally love this stuff and will keep ordering it.
Update. It grows on you. My favorite lotion now.  Not quite the Nag Champa I was hoping for, the sandalwood is too strong. Still smells good. I won’t return it, but not sure I will buy again...

reviews.t: I absolutely love The Naked Bee products
reviews.x: I absolutely love The Naked Bee products.  I have very sensitive skin and their products do not bother me.
Love this lotion!! Smells amazing. I've been using this brand for years, and a little goes a long way!
Love the smell of this stuff. Absorbs nicely, no greasiness, hands are nice and smooth now.

reviews.t: doesn't really smell like the incense
reviews.x: Moisturizing..doesn't really smell like the incense, but nice
Love the Naked Bee line and have many hooked now too.

reviews.t: Cruelty free, fresh scent, very moisturizing
reviews.x: I like everything about this product. First off, it's cruelty free. Secondly, the scent is so fresh and relaxing that I look forward to putting it on my hands every night before bed. I only use it at night because that's all I need it, it's that moisturizing. This two-pack was only slightly more than just one from another seller, so it was a great buy. Highly recommend!

I love this hand and body cream.  It is rich but not greasy and the Nag Champa scent is lovely and very relaxing. It really does smell like Nag Champa incense!  The ingredients are natural and cruelty free...very important to me.  I will definitely purchase this hand cream again. Try the Lavendar too.

My aunt and I were on our way to Mississippi two weeks ago and we stopped in a gas station that had this lotion on display.  I tried the tester of this lotion and fell in love with the scent and texture.  It was pretty expensive in the gas station so I looked on Amazon.  Thank You!!!!!

I love Nag Champa incense. I love the other lotion by Naked Bee but this lotion was way too strong of a scent. I gave them to the nursing home that I work for as Bingo prize for the residents. Very sad that it didn’t work out as I was so forward to using it.

reviews.t: Great scent, very light weight, very runny.
reviews.x: I love the scent. Not too strong, not offensive in a crowd. I just wish that it was a thicker formula. This lotion is really runny, and I don't find it very moisturizing. I find that I need to reapply with every single hand washing.

I really like this lotion. A little strong smelling at first but subsides, and leaves a nice smell throughout the day.  Lotion is light and does not feel tacky like some lotions do. leaves my skin moisturized. Love, love, love it.

Aside from being a great moisturizer and skin softener, the scent of this lotion lasts for a long time and is just great!  I've used it before, when I could find it, and ecstatic to have found it on Amazon.  Great stuff!!

reviews.t: I usually love the smell of Nag Champa
reviews.x: I usually love the smell of Nag Champa, but this smells like a really strong men's after shave. Does not compare to the Orange Blossom and Honey scent at all! I returned this item.
I purchased for my husband, but this smells so good I also use it. It's moisturizing, not too greasy. Note: I normally don't like the Nag Champa scent, but this is my exception.
I love this scent. I originally bought this lotion at Hallmark and now have purchased it, along with the body butter, here on Amazon. I am happy to be able to purchase it here.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent as pleasant and distinctive, often describing it as spicy, earthy, or musky rather than fruity or food-like.
Many reviewers say the lotion is moisturizing and keeps skin soft and smooth without being greasy.
Several reviewers mention it as a substitute for the discontinued sandalwood scent, with some saying it is just as good or better.
A few reviewers note the scent does not quite match their expectation of Nag Champa incense, with sandalwood coming through too strong.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and appreciate the ingredients.
